thread:
Sam (eng-infra): FYI provisioning Dedicated pool for acct ACCT-4921 in eu-west-2 is blocked by payments provider. Bank beneficiary verification failed: 'recipient name mismatch'.
Maya (finance): Ugh. Do we have the legal entity name they have on file? Could be a name-formatting issue (Ltd vs LLC).
Sam (eng-infra): Provider returned this error: `PAYEE_NAME_MISMATCH: beneficiary name 'Redwood Inference Inc' != registered 'Redwood Inference, Inc.'`
Priya (oncall): Typical. Can you paste the exact company name on the order/invoice we sent? Sometimes commas or punctuation trip the matching.
Sam (eng-infra): Order shows `Redwood Inference Inc` (no comma). Billing portal shows `Redwood Inference, Inc.`. I uploaded the official certificate of incorporation to the billing ticket (link: https://billing.example.com/tickets/4821).
Maya (finance): Got it. I'll refile with payments support. Also, do we have a fallback payment method? Wire vs ACH? Some banks validate differently.
Jordan (sales): If they need an invoice/PO to match exactly, we can issue a revised invoice with the registered name. I can sign off on a corrected invoice today — need a POC for approvals.
Alex (ops): Short-term workaround: if we can temporarily attach a company card for the reservation we can avoid losing the capacity slot. But that requires cardholder + CFO approval.
Sam (eng-infra): Trying to avoid swapping to card because this is a committed Dedicated reservation (contract value ~$42k/mo). Provider said automatic escalation will take 48-72h. That kills our launch window.
payments-bot: Payment attempt failed — code 409_BENEFICIARY_VALIDATION — see https://payments.example.com/errors/409_BENEFICIARY_VALIDATION
Priya (oncall): Can we fall back to smaller immediate capacity in another region temporarily (eu-west-1) and migrate once billing resolves? Any model-serving implications?
Alex (ops): We can spin a 2x A100 test pool in eu-west-1 but throughput will be lower and network egress costs differ. Also latency for customers in ireland will increase ~30-40ms.
Jordan (sales): If we lose the launch window it's ok to do a partial rollout. But customer contract expects 99.9 SLA after go-live. Need to check legal on amendment.
Maya (finance): I'll escalate to payments PM and request manual verification using the incorporation docs + W-9. Ask legal to confirm exact registered name string we should use.
Sam (eng-infra): Adding logs of provisioning CLI attempt:
```
redwood provision reserve --account ACCT-4921 --region eu-west-2 --sku a100-80gb --commit 3mo
Error: payment validation failed: PAYEE_NAME_MISMATCH
```
Maya (finance): Legal confirmed registered name: `Redwood Inference, Inc.`. Jordan — can you get sales to request a corrected invoice header?
Jordan (sales): On it. I'll ping Legal + Customer to approve small change (coma vs no-comma). Will cc Maya.
Priya (oncall): Also reminder: if provider re-processes verification we should avoid re-submitting duplicate attempts — that resets the retry clock. Coordination needed.
Sam (eng-infra): Noted. I'll patch the ticket with the correct invoice PDF and hold off on re-attempts. If payments don't clear by EOD tomorrow, we'll open the eu-west-1 fallback.
Maya (finance): Thanks — escalating now. :pray:
payments-bot: Ticket 4821 updated by Maya (finance) — manual verification requested. Estimated review: 24-48h.
Alex (ops): I'll prepare terraform plan for eu-west-1 fallback so we can spin up quickly if needed. Sharing the plan link in #eng-infra once ready.
Sam (eng-infra): Cool. Keep me posted. If legal needs any notarized docs let me know.
Jordan (sales): Customer ok with temporary region fallback as long as we trim expected latency in the release notes. I'll draft the customer comms.
Maya (finance): Closing loop here — payment PM acknowledged and asked for exact bank beneficiary format (no punctuation). Will report back with final status.
Sam (eng-infra): Thanks everyone.
